json.title: Endless Coastal Summer
json.logline: A young woman looks back on a golden summer drive along the coast where time seemed to stand still.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Felt piano strikes a quiet note over a still portrait
Gouache brushstrokes expand across the skyline
Coastal breeze lifts hair into golden light
Light flares brightly across camera lens
Wide sweeping view of golden ocean cliffs with warm air rushing
Layered memory collage of sparkling waves
Warm piano note decays as horizon glows softly

scenes.camera_note: Slow push toward the woman standing still against the distant city line
scenes.action: A young woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair gazes forward under warm dusk light.
scenes.setting: Rooftop overlooking a quiet city skyline at sunset

scenes.camera_note: Subtle lateral drift with background painterly depth
scenes.action: Gouache brushwork transforms the city into rolling coastal hills in golden light.
scenes.setting: Winding coastal highway lined with sage green grass and terracotta cliffs

scenes.camera_note: Tilting up from vintage car window frame to her face
scenes.action: Coastal wind lifts her wavy brown hair in warm amber sunlight.
scenes.setting: Passenger seat of a vintage convertible driving along a sea cliff

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push into her smiling profile bathed in golden lens flare
scenes.action: Sunlight flares across her face in the open ocean breeze.
scenes.setting: Coastal road approaching an open cliffside overlook

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping wide pull-out revealing the expansive shimmering ocean coastline
scenes.action: The convertible sails along the panoramic cliff road under a brilliant golden sky.
scenes.setting: Vast ocean coastline with glowing turquoise waves and golden sunset light

scenes.camera_note: Floating multi-layered gouache memory frames drifting horizontally
scenes.action: Overlapping painted vignettes display ocean spray and sunset road motion.
scenes.setting: Abstract dreamy backdrop with layered memory windows of the coastal trip

scenes.camera_note: Slow smooth backward drift away from the calm protagonist
scenes.action: The young woman sits quietly on a sandy dune watching the horizon dusk.
scenes.setting: Peaceful sand dunes at dusk looking out over a calm sea
